summary: May 5, 2026: Russell 2000 +1.41%, Nasdaq +0.90%, S&P 500 +0.78%, Dow +0.52%. Markets rebounded as U.S.-Iran truce held and oil prices eased slightly. Semiconductor strength (Micron +11%, Intel all-time high, AMD up). Oil: WTI $104.10/bbl (-2.22%), Brent $112.90/bbl (-1.38%).
